<?php
/**
 * phpMyAdmin configuration
 */

$cfg['blowfish_secret'] = '{blowfish_secret}';
$cfg['DefaultLang'] = 'en';
$cfg['ServerDefault'] = 1;
$cfg['UploadDir'] = '';
$cfg['SaveDir'] = '';

$i = 0;
$i++;
$cfg['Servers'][$i]['verbose'] = 'MySQL Server';
$cfg['Servers'][$i]['host'] = '{db_host}';
$cfg['Servers'][$i]['port'] = {db_port};
$cfg['Servers'][$i]['socket'] = '';
$cfg['Servers'][$i]['connect_type'] = 'tcp';
$cfg['Servers'][$i]['extension'] = 'mysqli';
$cfg['Servers'][$i]['auth_type'] = 'cookie';
$cfg['Servers'][$i]['user'] = '{db_username}';
$cfg['Servers'][$i]['password'] = '{db_password}';
$cfg['Servers'][$i]['AllowNoPassword'] = false;
$cfg['Servers'][$i]['only_db'] = '';
$cfg['Servers'][$i]['hide_db'] = '';
$cfg['Servers'][$i]['AllowDeny']['order'] = '';
$cfg['Servers'][$i]['AllowDeny']['rules'] = array();

// Security settings
$cfg['ForceSSL'] = false;
$cfg['CheckConfigurationPermissions'] = true;
$cfg['TempDir'] = './tmp/';
$cfg['UploadDir'] = './tmp/';
$cfg['SaveDir'] = './tmp/';

// Appearance
$cfg['DefaultTheme'] = 'pmahomme';
$cfg['ThemeManager'] = true;
$cfg['ThemeDefault'] = 'pmahomme';

// Language
$cfg['Lang'] = 'en';
$cfg['DefaultLang'] = 'en';
$cfg['FilterLanguages'] = array('ar', 'az', 'bn', 'bg', 'ca', 'cs', 'da', 'de', 'el', 'en', 'es', 'et', 'fa', 'fi', 'fr', 'gl', 'he', 'hr', 'hu', 'id', 'it', 'ja', 'ko', 'lt', 'lv', 'nl', 'pl', 'pt-BR', 'pt', 'ro', 'ru', 'si', 'sk', 'sr@latin', 'sr', 'sv', 'th', 'tr', 'uk', 'zh-TW', 'zh');

// Misc
$cfg['MaxRows'] = 50;
$cfg['ExecTimeLimit'] = 300;
$cfg['MemoryLimit'] = '128M';
$cfg['CheckConfigurationPermissions'] = false;
$cfg['LinkLengthLimit'] = 1000;
$cfg['CSPAllow'] = 'frame-ancestors';
